items.title: BlackRock's IBIT Dominates Spot Bitcoin ETF Holdings
items.description: Bitcoin held by spot ETFs by issuer, quarterly since April 2024: BlackRock's IBIT near 800K BTC, far ahead of Fidelity, Grayscale and the rest.
items.reason: Spot bitcoin ETFs saw more than $2.5B of net redemptions this month as BTC heads for a seventh straight weekly loss.

items.title: Strategy's preferreds yield 9.7–13.7% vs 8.1% for US junk bonds (Feb 2025–Oct 2026)
items.description: Current yields on Strategy's STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD preferreds vs the US high-yield bond effective yield, Feb 2025 to Oct 2026.
items.reason: STRC closed near $96, its lowest in about three months, despite Strategy's heavy preferred buybacks.

items.title: Waymo vs Tesla: Fully Autonomous Taxi Fleets
items.description: Fully autonomous taxi fleets: Waymo (~4,000, official statements and NHTSA filings) vs Tesla (1,507 on the Texas DMV registry as of Nov 17, 2026).
items.reason: Tesla's Texas Cybercab registrations keep climbing and it opened Cybercab purchases to select customers.
